items.html: Jack Dillé — warm, personal-history contact, not a recruiter relationship. The referral carries relationship weight, not just a forwarded link.
Rain — global stablecoin payments infra for enterprises/neobanks/platforms/AI agents; issues Visa+Mastercard cards at 175M+ merchant locations, 220+ countries; 100+ organizations trust it today.
Funding — $250M Series C, Jan 2026, led by ICONIQ; Sapphire, Dragonfly, Bessemer, Galaxy, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, Endeavor Catalyst also in. Hypergrowth-stage, well-capitalized.

The role — core member of the Internal AI team: audit workflows, build/ship AI agents & apps end-to-end, drive AI-adoption culture, build the SOPs/agent-library/governance primitives. This is internal-AI-enablement-as-a-job, not a customer-facing product role.
Requirements — 3-6 years product/product-ops/FDE/solutions-eng/TPM; fluent with Claude Code/Cursor, SQL & BI tools, APIs, scripting; comfortable with ambiguity; ideally Series A-C startup background.

Culture — open/flat structure, unlimited PTO with a 10-day minimum (a positive-screen signal: they're worried about under-use, not over-use), full remote/hybrid flexibility language despite this specific req being on-site.

blocks.intro: This is a relationship conversation first, a role conversation second. Don't invert that order.

items.html: How's Jack doing, genuinely — catch up before pivoting to the ask. · look for: does the conversation open naturally, or does it feel forced by the ask
Is this req actively being worked, or just posted and sitting? · look for: a specific, current answer, not "I think so"
Who owns the Internal AI team / who would the hiring manager be? · look for: a name Jack can actually connect to
What does "AI Native Builder" mean in practice at Rain today — what has the team already shipped? · look for: concrete examples, not aspiration language
Landmine: don't lead with the resume/bundle before re-establishing the relationship — Jack was kind once; don't make the first re-contact transactional.
Landmine: zero prior experience with stablecoins/crypto/payments compliance — address this head-on rather than letting the resume imply domain fluency that isn't there.
